description: Scores a real-estate office’s or developer’s current website (0–100) on what brings clients: secure address, speed, phone screens, search title and description, WhatsApp and call buttons, structured data, share picture, a form, languages. Reads only the one public page given. Pair it with real_estate_website_builder to show the owner a better site.
name: real_estate_website_check
title: Real-estate website check
